steps.message: Open the file task.html in Downloads in the file manager; when prompted open it with Chrome. Then create a drawing using the three colors shown at the top and hit submit.
Execute: adb shell "am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d file:///sdcard/Download/task.html -t text/html com.android.chrome"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d file:///sdcard/Download/task.html -t text/html com.android.chrome""
